row.reason: Paylocity sells cloud HCM and payroll software (payroll, HR, tax filing) to mid-sized employers across industries. SS&C sells investment-management software and fund administration and transfer agency outsourcing to asset managers, hedge funds, banks and insurers, plus healthcare payer software. The products differ and so do the buyers. Both earn subscription revenue, but that is too generic to count as overlap. SS&C's enterprise workflow automation (WorkHQ) is generic wording and not payroll or HR.
